Lower Text: [When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞.
Upper Text: This card in the hand may digivolve onto any of your yellow Tamers as if onto a level 3 yellow Digimon.

[When Digivolving] If [KendoGarurumon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or you have a black or purple Digimon or Tamer, this Digimon may digivolve into [AncientGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring digivolution requirements. If this effect digivolved, delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.
